body:
Won't work, HarfBuzz uses Unicode normalization methods from UCD, and data for these are NOT included in export template (when using built-in ICU). It is always included with editor, or in the exported PCK if "include text server data" option is selected in the project settings (about 5 MB).

It can be enabled for editor only, but for 50 KB it probably not worth it since ICU/HB UCD might be out of sync and result in different behavior in editor and exported project.
